olivia (product): Drafting the internal release note for v2.4.0. Target change window Tue 2026-03-17 22:00-23:00 UTC. Main points: model pin, quantization toggle, canary rollout with automatic fallback to v2.3.8, console metrics fix, and a small batching bugfix. Can folks review the blurb and the deploy/rollback plan?

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅
Canary on staging: green (2026-03-16 14:12 UTC). No known blocking alerts. Scheduled window is free.

sam (eng-releases): Agree with the outline. A couple requests: pin to a commit hash (not just tag) for the model, include explicit rollback target (v2.3.8), and add the rollout percentages. I can own the deploy. Propose start 22:10 UTC (10m after window start) to give last-minute sanity checks.

maria (eng-runtime): Important: disable KV cache prefix warming during canary to avoid OOMs we've seen in previous model changes. Suggested runtime overrides for canary:
```
runtime.cache.prefix_warm=false
runtime.max_batch_tokens=4096
quantization.fallback=false
```
Also recommend running canary instances with `--probe-connections 2` to reduce spike risk.

rahul (eng-sre): I'll be on-call for the window. Confirming: no infra migrations in this release, correct? If so SRE standby is straightforward. Rollback trigger proposal: latency > baseline +30% OR error rate > baseline +0.5% sustained for 10 minutes -> immediate rollback. Also add a manual rollback button in the deploy job.

jen (docs): Here's a first draft internal blurb for #all-hands / internal-release channel: 
"Release v2.4.0 (internal): Updating serving model to rmd-llama-13b pinned at commit 8c7b2f6 (improves generation quality for long-context prompts). Performance tweaks and batching fixes reduce median latency by ~7% on mid-size loads. Console: fixed metric grouping bug affecting token cost breakdown. IMPORTANT: We’ve enabled a quantization toggle — see release notes for potential small embedding variance. Canary rollout with automatic fallback to v2.3.8. Release window Tue 22:00-23:00 UTC; SRE on-call throughout."

olivia (product): Small edits: call out the canary progression (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and note that we hold at 25% for 30m before final ramp. Also mention the pinned model commit explicitly (8c7b2f6).

sam (eng-releases): I'll put the rollout policy in the deploy job and add health checks. Planned rollout policy in deploy config: 
```
canary: 5% for 30m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% for 15m
health_checks:
  - p50_latency <= baseline + 15%
  - error_rate <= baseline + 0.5%
rollback_trigger: breach for 10m
fallback_model: v2.3.8
pin_model_commit: 8c7b2f6
```
I'll add a note to the job description: operator can force rollback via the UI button; script will run `./deploy --rollback v2.3.8`.

maria (eng-runtime): Confirmed re: cache. Also we should set `kv_cache.max_entries=20000` for the canary to limit memory. I'll update runtime config in the canary stack.

jen (docs): Updated the blurb with olivia's edits and added a short "what to watch for" list for internal readers: small embedding variance with quantization, short-lived latency upticks during ramp. Dropping the final blurb here for copy/paste: 
"Internal announcement (final):
Release v2.4.0 — Model update & performance fixes
What's changing: model pinned to rmd-llama-13b @ commit 8c7b2f6; batching and runtime optimizations; console metrics bugfix.
Why it matters: Slight quality improvements on long-context prompts and ~7% median latency improvement in internal benchmarks.
Rollout plan: Canary 5% for 30m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% for 15m. SRE on-call during window. Automatic fallback to v2.3.8 on health check failures.
Watchouts: Potential minor embedding variance when quantization is enabled; brief latency spikes during ramp.
Window: Tue 2026-03-17 22:00-23:00 UTC.
"

olivia (product): Nice. One more tiny edit: change "short-lived latency upticks" -> "brief latency spikes" and add a link to the post-deploy evaluation doc. Otherwise LGTM.

sam (eng-releases): Scheduled deploy job created: job-id 20260317-2210-rls. I'll kick off canary at 22:10 UTC and monitor with the team. Script for rollback is attached to the job.

deploy-bot: Deploy job 20260317-2210-rls scheduled by sam (eng-releases). Canary step created at 5% with auto-promote flags. Logs will stream to https://deploys.internal/reports/20260317-2210-rls\. 

rahul (eng-sre): On-call confirmed. If anything goes wrong ping me @rahul and I'll hit the rollback button. :thumbsup:

jen (docs): I'll push the internal blurb to #all-hands and update the GH release notes after the canary. Leaving the draft in the pastebin for final sign-off: https://internal.paste/rls-v2.4.0

olivia (product): Thanks all — final sign-off from product. Please add reactions in-thread if you approve so I can publish the internal announcement at rollout start.

sam (eng-releases): +1

maria (eng-runtime): +1

jen (docs): +1

rahul (eng-sre): +1

deploy-bot: Update: job 20260317-2210-rls will create a rollback snapshot prior to canary.

olivia (product): Publishing-ready. I'll post in #all-hands at kickoff with the final blurb. Good luck team.
